usage.at-bg: Page ground behind the body gradient; ring colour of the history-count badge (box-shadow 0 0 0 2px). The body itself paints --at-gradient, a 145deg sweep bg → surface → panel → surface → bg (light: bg → #ffffff → elev → text-dim → bg), carried in bundle.css because a gradient is not a colour token.
usage.at-surface: Second stop of the body gradient; alpha-tinted as the .section card ground (rgba(14,28,50,.85)), the .player shell (.6), preset cards (.5), FAQ items (.4) and inputs (.4).
usage.at-panel: Toast ground (.toast-item) and <option> ground inside .form-select; middle stop of the body gradient.
usage.at-elev: Highest raised surface; third stop of the light gradient. Rarely painted directly — the editor and sidebar use alpha tints of at-bg/at-surface instead.
usage.at-text: Primary text: body copy, headings, labels, inputs, list rows. 16.4:1 on at-bg dark, 10.3:1 light. Also the end colour of the 3px gradient rule atop every .section.
usage.at-text-dim: Secondary copy: .small-text/.form-text help lines, .text-muted, preset descriptions, intro paragraphs, outline-button labels. 14.3:1 dark, 6.0:1 light on at-bg.
usage.at-muted: Tertiary ink: eyebrow labels, row meta, chevrons, resting transport/aux icons, status dot when stopped; its alpha tints draw every hairline border (rgba(122,141,160,.12–.25)) and the slider track. 5.4:1 on at-bg dark but only 3.9:1 on at-elev and 4.0:1 on light at-bg — keep it to labels ≥0.7rem bold or decorative marks.
usage.at-primary: Brand gold. Fills active tabs, active transport play, slider thumbs, progress fills, the section top rule, selected-row bar; tints (rgba(201,152,77,.06–.15)) draw hover grounds, icon tiles, badges and chips. As text it reads 7.1:1 on dark at-bg but only 2.3:1 on light at-bg — the source still uses it for text (preset banner, track name, chips); flagged, kept exact.
usage.at-primary-600: Primary hover in the light theme (.btn-primary:hover). Unused in dark, where hover goes to at-primary-hover (#f8e1a9).
usage.at-primary-700: Darkest gold step; defined for pressed states, currently unreferenced by component CSS.
usage.at-primary-fg: Ink on at-primary fills: active tab, .btn-primary, active play button, history-count badge, active preset play. 7.1:1 dark; 4.4:1 light (just under AA for the 0.85rem button label — source value, kept).
usage.at-success: Positive signal: playing status dot and label, .btn-success ground (ink at-on-success), toast-success accent, SIN wave chip. 9.3:1 on dark at-bg; 1.8:1 on light — the light toast swaps to at-success-light-ui, everything else keeps this value.
usage.at-danger: Destructive and alert signal: .btn-danger ground (ink at-on-danger), hearing warning title/icon/dismiss, toast-error accent, SAW wave chip. 5.9:1 on dark at-bg; 2.8:1 on light cream (source, flagged).
usage.at-warning: Paused status dot/label and toast-warning accent. Same hex as at-primary — by design gold doubles as the caution tone.
usage.at-info: Deep blue FILL only: .btn-secondary ground, light-theme focus border, light preset tags/play button, toast-info accent. Never as text on dark surfaces (2.3:1) — use at-info-text.
usage.at-info-text: Readable info tone for text: app subtitle, resting tab labels, FAQ answers, TRI wave chip. 8.3:1 on dark at-bg; in light it equals at-info (7.2:1).
usage.at-border-color: Colour half of --at-border (1px solid …): input and toast borders. The composite --at-border itself ships in bundle.css.

extra.name: at-hairline
extra.usage: Literal in oscillator.css, player.css, presets.css (not a CSS variable): the 1px border of cards, editor, player shell, transport group, wave buttons, preset cards. Decorative — does not need 3:1.

extra.name: at-scrim
extra.usage: Literal: inner control ground inside panels — wave buttons, aux buttons, editor header, transport group. Darker (.4–.5) for the tab bar and transport.

extra.name: at-primary-tint
extra.usage: Literal gold wash: hover ground of tabs, transport, menu items, FAQ questions; resting ground of preset banner, preset icon tile, preset tags, history buttons. .06 for list-row hover, .12–.15 for icon tiles, chips, active aux.

extra.name: at-primary-hover
extra.usage: Literal in button.css: .btn-primary:hover ground. Dark lightens toward at-text-dim; light darkens to at-primary-600.

extra.name: at-success-hover
extra.usage: Literal in button.css: .btn-success:hover ground.

extra.name: at-danger-hover
extra.usage: Literal in button.css: .btn-danger:hover ground.

extra.name: at-on-success
extra.usage: Literal ink on .btn-success (9.3:1 on at-success in both themes).

extra.name: at-on-danger
extra.usage: Literal ink on .btn-danger — 3.1:1 on at-danger, below AA for 0.85rem text (source, flagged). The hearing-warning dismiss button uses at-on-danger-deep instead.

extra.name: at-on-danger-deep
extra.usage: Literal ink on the hearing-warning dismiss pill (5.8:1 on at-danger).

extra.name: at-on-info
extra.usage: Ink on at-info fills: .btn-secondary, light preset play active. 7.2:1 dark, 7.3:1 light.

extra.name: at-navy-deep
extra.usage: Literal in button.css: light-theme .btn-secondary:hover ground (ink at-on-info, 10.3:1). Same hex as light at-text.

extra.name: at-success-light-ui
extra.usage: Literal in toast.css: light-theme toast-success border and icon (2.8:1 on white — decorative accent beside an icon glyph; flagged).

extra.name: at-wave-pulse
extra.usage: Literal in oscillator.css: PLS wave chip ink and its .15 tint ground. 4.7:1 on dark at-surface, 3.7:1 light.

extra.name: at-wave-organ
extra.usage: Literal in oscillator.css: ORG wave chip ink and its .15 tint ground. 6.2:1 on dark at-surface, 2.7:1 light (flagged).

extra.name: at-hearing-ground
extra.usage: Literal in hearing-warning.css: the warning banner's red-tinted glass ground (blur 12px), bordered with at-danger at .4 / rgba(200,60,60,.35).

spacing.note: Source scale --space-N in rem (4px base). Component paddings outside the scale (0.55rem 1.1rem buttons, 0.4rem 0.9rem pills, 10px gaps) stay literal in bundle.css.

usage.space-1: 4px — tab-bar inner padding, badge/toggle gaps, list padding, icon-caption gap in wave buttons.
usage.space-2: 8px — default inline gap: tab gap, row gaps, menu item padding, toast stack gap, grid row gap.
usage.space-3: 12px — collapsible header and toast padding (vertical), player bar padding, sidebar stack gap, wave button padding.
usage.space-4: 16px — form-group margin, editor section padding, card padding, master-detail grid gap, FAQ question padding.
usage.space-5: 20px — body padding, container side padding, section narrow spacing, preset-card and editor horizontal padding.
usage.space-6: 24px — .section padding, h2 margin-bottom, params-grid column gap.
usage.space-8: 32px — tab bar margin-bottom; the largest step (no space-7).

radius.note: Three source variables plus the literal radii the components use.

usage.at-radius: Sections, tab bar, oscillator editor, collapsible, player shell, hearing-warning banner, editor placeholder. 10px ≤768px, 8px ≤480px on .section.
usage.at-radius-sm: Tab buttons, wave buttons, history buttons, aux player buttons.
usage.at-radius-xs: Buttons, inputs and selects, list rows, menu items and their icon tiles, collapsible icon tile.

extra.name: radius-card
extra.usage: Literal: preset cards, preset banner, preset icon tile, FAQ items, toasts, transport group, progress bar track.

extra.name: radius-transport
extra.usage: Literal: .transport-btn inside the 10px transport group (3px inset).

extra.name: radius-chip
extra.usage: Literal: wave chips and wave badges; preset scrollbar thumb.

extra.name: radius-pill
extra.usage: Literal: preset tags, preset play button, hearing-warning dismiss. 999px for the active badge and history count; 50% for toggle dots, status dot, slider thumbs.

shadow.note: Elevation is soft and navy-tinted; light theme shadows are navy at low alpha. Hover lifts add translateY(-1px).

extra.name: shadow-section
extra.usage: Literal: .section cards.

extra.name: shadow-hover
extra.usage: Literal: .btn:hover lift; preset cards hover use 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.12).

extra.name: shadow-tab-active
extra.usage: Literal: .tab-btn.active glow under the gold tab.

extra.name: shadow-player-bar
extra.usage: Literal: the fixed .player-bar casts upward.

extra.name: shadow-focus
extra.usage: Literal: input/select focus halo beside a solid at-primary (dark) or at-info (light) border. Buttons use outline 2px solid at-primary instead.

extra.name: shadow-thumb
extra.usage: Literal: range slider thumb; 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35) on hover with scale(1.15).

duration.note: Two source variables; easing is always ease. prefers-reduced-motion disables the collapsible and chevron transitions.

usage.at-speed: Default transition: hover grounds, chevrons, slider thumbs, status dot colour.
usage.at-speed-slow: Theme switch (background, color, border, shadow on themed elements) and the collapsible 0fr→1fr height animation.

extra.name: duration-toast
extra.usage: Literal: toast enter (cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)); leave 300ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,1,1).

extra.name: duration-pulse
extra.usage: Literal: playing status dot opacity pulse 1→.4→1, ease-in-out, infinite.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Base h1 rule: clamp(1.6rem, 1.2rem + 1.5vw, 2.2rem) — upper bound listed. In the app the only h1 carries .app-title, which wins.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: Page header title (.app-title), centred, margin-bottom 0.4rem. 1.5rem ≤768px, 1.3rem ≤480px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heading inside a wide .section; margin-bottom space-6; a 60×2px at-primary underline via ::after. 1.3rem ≤768px. Dark theme adds text-shadow 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.25).

styles.name: h2-narrow
styles.usage: .section-narrow h2 — Filter, Recording, Presets and FAQ tabs; margin-bottom space-4.

styles.name: editor-title
styles.usage: .osc-editor-title (h3) in the oscillator editor header, followed by the wave badge.

styles.name: sidebar-title
styles.usage: .osc-sidebar-title (h2) above the oscillator list; leading icon in at-primary at 0.9rem.

styles.name: preset-name
styles.usage: .preset-name (h3) on preset cards; margin-bottom space-1; no underline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Erstelle und gestalte individuelle Alarmtöne direkt im Browser.
styles.usage: Default body copy in at-text on the body gradient; antialiased. Supreme ships one weight (400) — 500/600/700 are browser-synthesised.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: .app-subtitle under the title, in at-info-text. 0.85rem ≤768px.

styles.name: intro
styles.sample: Wähle ein Preset, um sofort loszulegen.
styles.usage: .presets-intro paragraph in at-text-dim, margin-bottom space-6.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: .tab-btn label; at-info-text resting, at-text on hover, at-primary-fg when active. 0.8rem ≤768px; label hidden ≤480px (icon only).

styles.name: faq-question
styles.usage: .faq-question summary in at-text; 0.85rem ≤480px.

styles.name: faq-answer
styles.usage: .faq-answer body in at-info-text; 0.8rem ≤480px.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: .form-control and .form-select text in at-text; 16px ≤768px to stop iOS zoom. Editor number pills add tabular-nums and weight 500.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: .form-label above every control, at-text, margin-bottom 0.4rem; 0.8rem ≤480px.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: .btn label; padding 0.55rem 1.1rem, icon gap 0.4rem. 0.8rem ≤480px.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: .btn-sm — editor header actions and convert buttons; padding 0.35rem 0.7rem.

styles.name: history-button
styles.usage: .history-btn label; padding 0.5rem; at-text.

styles.name: small-text
styles.sample: Die Aufnahme beginnt, sobald der Alarm läuft.
styles.usage: .small-text / .form-text help lines in at-text-dim, margin-top 0.2rem.

styles.name: row-name
styles.usage: .osc-row-name in list rows; ellipsis on overflow.

styles.name: toast-body
styles.usage: .toast-body message in at-text; word-break break-word.

styles.name: menu-name
styles.usage: .settings-menu-name — primary line of a save-options item.

styles.name: menu-desc
styles.usage: .settings-menu-desc — second line of a menu item, at-muted.

styles.name: collapsible-title
styles.usage: .collapsible-title in the sidebar dropdown header, at-text.

styles.usage: .hearing-warning__title in at-danger.

styles.name: track-name
